paragraphs: Responserack sells fire department records software whose core is incident reporting exported to NFIRS/NERIS. The company describes the product as a replacement for legacy reporting systems. Delivery is cloud-based and managed, with nothing for a department to install on its own computers.

Firefighters reach the system from their phones, and departments can use apparatus tablets they already have. A mobile application is offered for iPhone and Android. Alongside incident reports, the listed features include training records, member hour reports, apparatus checks, and computer aided dispatch integration.

The stated audience is volunteer fire departments rather than career departments. The about page credits the product to Adam Jack, named there as founder and a volunteer firefighter. Responserack is identified as a registered trade name of Neukadye LLC.
